name: Stevie or Fanny
description: We need someone that loves special needs babies! We believe this guy is blind. Most shelters would put him down, but we think he’s got a shot at a good life in the right home! References and/or previous experience with a special needs dog required.

name: Moon
description:
Someone needs to adopt moon before I do… she’s 12-15 weeks old, belly full of worms (we can fix that) and she’s getting spayed and bloodwork done! Now let’s talk about her personality…
She is potty trained (scared pees a little but that’ll stop) she’s so sweet and knows she was rescued. Those make the best dogs. She’s gentle and sweet. Wonderful girl.
